text:
Morgan Lee: Quick async — Cascade private rollout status. Customer wants VPC cutover this Friday EOD. Current blockers: 1) airgap image sync failing on staging 2) egress NAT rules missing 3) TLS cert rotation pending. Can owners confirm?

Lucas Chen: I can own NAT rules. I'll open a CR and ping netops. ETA end of day tomorrow.

Anya Patel: TLS cert rotation blocked by KMS key access. Security told me they need the customer's KMS ARN. @Tomás can you share?

Tomás Rivera: Sharing now — pasted ARN in convo. Also FYI the customer's internal PKI requires SHA256 key signing which needs an extra step.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-8293 (private-cutover/cascade) — contains logs and failing rsync.

Morgan Lee: thanks. Lucas — for NAT can you confirm fallback path? we need an egress fallback to our relay in case customer blocks.

Lucas Chen: plan: primary NAT to their NAT gateway, fallback to our egress relay in same region. I'll add iptables snippet in the ticket.

Lucas Chen: snippet:
```bash
# fallback route
ip route add default via 10.0.0.1 dev eth0 metric 100
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
```

Anya Patel: KMS ARN received. @infra-oncall we need role mapping so we'll be able to sign. Can you assign?

infra-oncall: @Anya assigned to SEC-4521. Need the customer's principal and the allowed operations list (Decrypt, Sign). Send via secure slack dm or ticket.

Tomás Rivera: I uploaded the airgap images to s3-prod-edge but rsync failing with timeout. Logs attached in INFRA-8293 — looks like port 873 getting reset.

Morgan Lee: Is this a firewall rule on customer's side or our egress proxy? Who can run a port check?

Lucas Chen: I'll run a quick nmap from our staging egress and post results.

Lucas Chen: nmap results: port 873 filtered from staging.e2e -> cascade-edge: timeout.

Tomás Rivera: so customer firewall blocking. @eng-account exec to nudge them.

Morgan Lee: Action items:
- Lucas: NAT + fallback config + nmap results — due tomorrow EOB
- Anya: coordinate KMS principal & update SEC-4521 — due today
- Tomás: re-run rsync after firewall change, post logs to INFRA-8293 — immediate
- Morgan: reach out to account lead and confirm Friday cutover contingency plan

Tomás Rivera: I'll also add a backoff retry to rsync (30s -> 5min) to tolerate transient drops:
```bash
rsync --partial --timeout=60 --contimeout=30 --retries=5 src/ dst/
```

Anya Patel: small ask — can we get a canary window instead of full cutover? 1 hour slice to validate images.

Morgan Lee: agreed. We'll propose 1-hour canary starting 10:00 AM Fri. @eng-account please confirm with customer.

eng-account: Pinged customer (email + calendar). Awaiting reply. If no reply by 16:00 today we'll auto-move to contingency plan ALPHA (rollback + extended canary).

Morgan Lee: Thanks team. I'll update the ticket INFRA-8293 with this thread summary.

deploy-bot: INFRA-8293 updated with thread summary by Morgan Lee.
